label: rare blip at the start of recall (delimiter / first copy step), mostly in L=3 and L=8-9 sequences
explanation: Very sparse reset-gate unit (0.03% of steps). Never fires during the original-token phase or after the first copy step: all activations are at recall_idx 0 or 1. Two position pockets: (a) L=3 sequences at the <DEL> step (32% of mass) and the following step (9%); (b) L=9 (50% of mass) and L=8 (9%) sequences at the first copy step, i.e. right after <DEL> when the first original token is fed back. It does not fire at all for L=4..7 (only 5 activations at L=7). The position predicate covers ~99% of mass but precision is only ~1%: even inside these slots it fires on a small minority of sequences. Within pocket (b) the fed-back first token matters (l strongest, then a, c, o: restricting to those gives 45% recall at 7% precision); in pocket (a) sequences containing digit 0 are enriched (largest activations e.g. d u 0, d t 0, i t 0) but 0 is neither necessary nor sufficient. Magnitudes are tiny (max 0.051, median 0.009); top activations come from both pockets. Token-level selectivity beyond position was not captured.
